findings.finding: The upstream go-utils module is split: stringcase, sliceutil and fieldmaskutil live inside module github.com/tx7do/go-utils@v1.1.40, while mapper@v0.0.3 and copierutil@v0.0.8 are separate modules. Provenance and LICENSE handling must be per archive, which is why three LICENSE files travel with the 26 staged files.

4 of the 95 consumers live inside pkg/localdeps/go-crud/entgo (field/utils.go, filter/filter_processor.go, repository.go, update/update.go). They were rewired like any other consumer and are covered by the same guard check; activating a package therefore also removes the localdeps subtree's dependency on the old path.

Activating sliceutil introduced the repository's first direct import of golang.org/x/exp/constraints. go.mod now classifies it as direct. This is a real requirement-scope change that a reviewer should see, and it is produced by make build_only rather than by hand.

TestBootstrapPostgres fails when its GOV_BOOTSTRAP_TEST_DSN precondition is satisfied: dbbootstrap.Initialize accepts a truncated catalog (catalog[1:]) where the test requires an error (app/admin/service/internal/data/bootstrap_postgres_test.go:58). It is skipped in normal runs, so the repository never sees this. Measured identical on freshly recreated databases at accepted_head a17cf52 and after T03, therefore a pre-existing defect unrelated to the takeover. Not repaired: the failing statement is a production-behaviour assertion, which the fixture-repair authorization explicitly excludes (conditions 2, 3 and 8). Reported for the owner.

go vet reports 'assignment copies lock value to ref' at app/admin/service/internal/service/accelerator_joint_http_test.go:503 (a protobuf message containing sync.Mutex is copied by value). The file is untouched by T03 and the diagnostic is identical at accepted_head. Reported, not changed.

Seven further repository tests are gated behind fixtures this task was not authorized to create (populated-restore, upgraded-old-backup, OS subprocess helper, joint B PostgreSQL/Redis, private formal process fixture, two disposable-PostgreSQL onboarding cases). They are recorded as not_run with the repository's own reason and were verified to behave the same at accepted_head.

fieldmaskutil ships only Test_NestedMaskFromPaths plus a benchmark: FilterByFieldMask, NormalizeFieldMaskPaths and NilValuePaths have no upstream test at all. T03.md forbids changing their behaviour and allows only a minimal counter-example where coverage is missing; this round exercised them through the existing repository converter and Role/Language update suites, which do cover mask-out fields, nil values and zero values. Expanding direct unit coverage of these three functions is a candidate for the T09/T10 register, not a silent addition here.
migrate_imports scan counts 1307 Go files; 401 still declare at least one github.com/tx7do import. That is the measured backlog for T04-T15 and the reason the upstream modules stay in go.mod.
